account_status.notes: No reach restriction shown at the observation; eligibility does not guarantee distribution.

limitations: Observation time and timezone were not captured; do not invent a clock time.
Exact start/end of the displayed last-30-days window were not captured.
The profile follower count is a point-in-time count, not attributed Reel follows.
Account-period totals must not be compared as equal-scope totals with Reel lifetime snapshots.
Follower split is a percentage of views, not a percentage of reach.
The UI did not expose watch time, retention, skip rate, or an organic/paid breakdown in the inspected views.
